title: News 12 Investigates: ECU professor explains how AI is helping military intelligence
script:
East Carolina University assistant professor David Hart explains how AI is helping military intelligence operations.
Defense sectors use these advanced systems to process massive amounts of operational data quickly.
Analysts previously sifted through endless manual reports before machine learning entered the workflow.
Human commanders still keep final control over major strategic decisions and the use of force.
Would you trust an algorithm with national defense strategy?
